why: Item 3/14 mixes fighting an attack with restoring and maintaining damaged figures, so the boundary between defending and repairing is the hardest to draw in this batch.

why.T3-001: The room runs its own April Fools material and readers dispute whether an image is an April Fools joke or a fish story (C0622300, C0098913), staging and testing the room's own fakes rather than ordinary in-jokes (T3-031).

why.T3-041: The call is for another SpaceX logo beside the completed ASDS and falcon, i.e. a further piece (C0869934, C1532665), not the room's first mark (T3-033).

why.T3-005: The lead is an attack under way (Lucio, robots, Swedes) with calls to fight back and hold (C0782964, C1045261, C0306852).
why.T3-021: Beside the fighting there is a distinct standing routine of restoring and maintaining the damaged figures (C0812158, C0931186, C0228027).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-005's gate reaches the attack and the fight but not the standing routine of restoring and maintaining the figures once damage is done.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0812158 reports the chicken half restored and C0228027 that it is fairly rebuilt - repair of changed pixels that T3-021's gate names.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-021; dropping it would lose the repair and maintenance work that went on beside the defence.

why.T3-014: Members set up and send people to the #SpaceX IRC for canvas coordination, giving the channel and a webIRC entry (C0098515, C1363347).

why.T3-034: A member asks where the work is and another supplies the location (C0096826 asks 'Where is this?', C0831964 gives the canvas link) - a request for coordinates and its answer.

why.T3-001: The room stages self-contained April Fools performances (C1072878 admits it was an April Fool's humour attempt; C0103836 is the love-story bit), its own April Fools fakes rather than ordinary in-jokes (T3-031).

why.T3-022: The room moves or restarts its build when space is occupied or contested (C0603898 decides to relocate after being fought for the area; C0274145 and C0864806 shift the chicken to the starfruit), relocating after losing the spot rather than yielding to a neighbour's request (T3-039).

why.T3-010: Neighbouring rooms settle borders, overlaps and compromises with no fight to end: C1143445 negotiates with r/Overwatch over the Junimo, C1187351 offers to trim the chicken to fit the HotS border, C1288937 offers a compromise.

why.T3-016: The room answers newcomers asking what the event is, explaining one pixel every five minutes (C0749003).
why.T3-031: Much of the item is the room's own YES catchphrase being asked about and explained (C0889600, C1381214, C0235991, C0134443), playing the room's running in-joke.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-016's gate reaches explaining the event itself but not the room's own YES catchphrase that newcomers also ask about and are answered.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0889600 asks what the Yes thing means and C1381214 answers with Elon's reply - the room's running in-joke played in talk, T3-031's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-031; dropping it would lose the local YES lore that makes up most of the item.

why.T3-033: Members offer the room ideas for what to put on the canvas - a Junimo, a stardrop, Elliott, Yoba's symbol (C1087480, C0559317, C0395885) - proposing the mark before hands are called (T3-002).

why.T3-054: After the official canvas ends members take the SpaceX logo up on a replacement canvas (C0315792 asks for help on the new r/place, C0238326 says they are creating the logo there).

why.T3-011: The room's members reach out to help other rooms' works with nothing asked - C1168147 calls Stardew to help r/Terraria and C1503731 calls help for the farm at r/farmcarrots - rather than recruiting other subs for Stardew's own work (T3-062).

why.T3-117: The two turns register the canvas's end - C0125623 announces 'place is now over' and C0806028 answers with a sad face.
